scripts.build: npm run build -w @wb/shared && npm run build -w @wb/web && npm run build -w @wb/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @wb/shared && node --import tsx --test packages/shared/test/*.test.ts packages/server/test/*.test.ts packages/web/src/**/*.test.ts
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @wb/shared && npm run dev -w @wb/server
